texte.Apposition du marquage CE visible sur le: CE marking affixed visibly on the system or its packaging after a successful conformity assessment.
texte.Base légale pour l'utilisation de donnée: Legal basis for the use of personal data in training. Data protection by design measures.
texte.Calcul : (points conformes + points en c: Calculation: (compliant points + points in progress × #) / applicable points × #. “Not applicable” takes a point out of the calculation; an unanswered point counts as zero. All points count equally, whatever their priority.
texte.Capacité d'enregistrement automatique de: Automatic event recording capability: timestamps, identifiers, input data, output decisions, identity of the operators who validated.
texte.Confirmer l'absence de systèmes de recon: Confirm the absence of unauthorised emotion recognition systems in the workplace/education or biometric categorisation of sensitive data.
texte.Consulter les documents de votre base de: Consult the documents in your knowledge base linked to the AI Act audit.
texte.Documentation claire pour les déployeurs: Clear documentation for deployers: identity of the provider, capabilities and limitations, expected performance, required input data, known residual risks.
texte.Documentation élaborée avant mise sur le: Documentation drawn up before placing on the market: general description, architecture, data used, performance, training method, test sheets.
texte.Déclaration sans délai des incidents gra: Reporting without delay of serious incidents or corrective actions to the Commission’s AI Office.
texte.Déclaration écrite signée par le fournis: Written declaration signed by the provider confirming the system’s conformity with the AI Act and other applicable regulations.
texte.Enregistrement obligatoire dans la base: Mandatory registration in the EU AI Office database before placing on the market for high-risk systems.
texte.Enregistrer l’état actuel de l’audit dan: Save the current state of the audit to the My assessments history.
texte.Faire relire cet audit par un expert CON: Have this audit reviewed by a CONSEILPREV expert →
texte.Formation adéquate des équipes manipulan: Adequate training of the teams handling or overseeing AI systems. Documented and regularly updated.
texte.Indique pour chaque section, a partir de: Indicates for each section, based on the actual systems in the AI register, whether it is applicable to the selected sector.
texte.Information claire que l'utilisateur int: Clear information that the user is interacting with an AI system (chatbot, agent). Marking of synthetic content (machine-readable watermarking).
texte.Interfaces homme-machine permettant la c: Human-machine interfaces enabling qualified operators to understand the outputs, interrupt or correct the system.
texte.Inventaire de tous les systèmes IA déplo: Inventory of all AI systems deployed or in development, identifying their type, purpose and sector of application.
texte.Jeux de validation et test satisfaisant: Validation and test sets meeting the quality criteria: representativeness, absence of known bias, fitness for purpose.
texte.Journaux conservés au minimum pour la du: Logs retained at least for the prescribed period and accessible to the competent authorities on request.
texte.Le fournisseur conserve la documentation: The provider keeps the technical documentation (Annex IV), the EU declaration of conformity and the quality management system documentation for # years after the system is placed on the market or put into service — an obligation distinct from the retention of logs (Art. #).
texte.Mise à jour continue du dossier techniqu: Continuous update of the technical file
texte.Mécanisme de surveillance permettant de: Monitoring mechanism for reclassifying a system if its use or capabilities change.
texte.Métriques de performance définies, mesur: Performance metrics defined, measured before deployment and continuously monitored. Documentation of acceptable variations.
texte.Notice d'utilisation conforme Art. #: Instructions for use compliant with Art. #
texte.Personnes responsables de la supervision: People responsible for oversight formally designated, trained in the system’s capabilities and limitations, able to detect anomalies.
texte.Plan de surveillance continue des perfor: Plan for continuous monitoring of performance and compliance after deployment. Collection and analysis of user feedback.

texte.Pour les fournisseurs GPAI : documentati: For GPAI providers: technical documentation, summary of the training content, copyright policy (Art. #(#)(a)), publicly available summary.
texte.Pour les modèles >#^# FLOPs : évaluation: For models >#^# FLOPs: adversarial evaluation (red-teaming), systemic risk assessment, report to the Commission.
texte.Pour les systèmes non classés haut risqu: For systems not classified as high-risk that come from Annex III areas (under the exception in Art. #(#)), formally document the assessment before placing on the market — the provider remains subject to the registration obligation (Art. #(#)).
texte.Pratiques de gestion des données : choix: Data management practices: design choices, collection, origin, objectives, nature, relevance, accuracy, completeness, potential bias.
texte.Processus itératif continu : identificat: Continuous iterative process: identification of known and foreseeable risks, estimation, evaluation, management measures. Planned across the whole life cycle.
texte.Procédure d'évaluation de conformité com: Complete conformity assessment procedure before placing on the market: self-assessment (internal control, Annex VI) or assessment by a notified body depending on the category of system. Annex VI details the criteria checked: quality management system, technical documentation, compliance with the robustness and cybersecurity requirements.
texte.Procédure de mise à jour du dossier lors: Procedure for updating the file whenever the system is substantially modified. Identification of versions.
texte.Qualité des données de validation et de: Quality of validation and test data
texte.Respecter les réservations de droits des: Respect the rights reservations of copyright holders (Art. #(#)(c)). Compliant opt-out mechanism.
